title: Maria's Food Day
text:
Maria likes breakfast. Every morning she eats bread, eggs and cheese. She drinks a glass of orange juice with her breakfast. Breakfast is her favorite meal of the day.

For lunch, Maria goes to a small café near her office. She often orders soup and a sandwich. On Fridays, she eats fish. After lunch, she drinks a cup of tea with milk.

questions.text: What does Maria drink with her breakfast?

options: At a small café near her office

questions.text: Why does Maria probably like the café near her office?
options: It is far from her office
It is convenient for her to eat there during work

questions.text: How does Maria probably feel about food?
options: She does not care about food
She enjoys eating and has regular meals

vocabulary.definition: the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning
two pieces of bread with food between them
a small place where you can buy coffee, tea and light food

paragraph_translations: Maria kahvaltıyı sever. Her sabah ekmek, yumurta ve peynir yer. Kahvaltısında bir bardak portakal suyu içer. Kahvaltı, günün en sevdiği öğünüdür.
Öğle yemeği için ofisinin yakınındaki küçük bir kafeye gider. Genellikle çorba ve bir sandviç sipariş eder. Cuma günleri balık yer. Öğle yemeğinden sonra sütlü bir fincan çay içer.
